title: Civil Engineering Draftsperson
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
What's your expected annual base salary?
How many years' experience do you have as a civil drafter?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
Have you completed a qualification in civil construction?
Do you have Engineering Drawing Interpretation experience?
gaps: Screening question asks years as a civil drafter; Marc's drafting is Advanced Diploma coursework, not paid drafting years
No apply email or instructions captured in the excerpt read
Advert asks for 'relevant experience in civil engineering drafting, design or construction documentation' without stating a minimum, so how much beyond coursework is required is unclear
rationale:
Civil drafting for solar projects: layouts, footings, earthworks, trenching and drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D; the ad names the Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design.
Drafting experience is coursework only against 'relevant experience'; Civil 3D highly regarded.
Sydney relocation; agency posting, SEEK route.
caution: Rough fit, not an interview forecast. Employer acceptance of a time-limited 485 visa and relocation are the main unknowns.
notes: Company field shows recruiter PlusJob; the advert names the actual employer as Sungold Solar, so no agency penalty applied. Claude: 'Relevant experience in civil engineering drafting, design or construction documentation' sets no minimum; the diploma's drafting and construction documentation is relevant experience and the letter says it is coursework only. Moved from mandatory_unresolved to gaps.
